title: Pure Marincess
summary: Marincess cards only, with generic staples. Marincess Blue Tang sends Marincess Sea Horse to the GY and digs three cards when used for a WATER Link. Sea Horse and Springirl summon themselves into the zones the Marincess Links point to, and the Links climb from Blue Slug and Coral Anemone up to Marincess Aqua Argonaut, which bounces a card and negates Spells/Traps on the opponent's turn. Marincess Battle Ocean equips spare Links to the Link in the Extra Monster Zone for ATK. Marincess Wave and Circulation can be activated from the hand once a Link-3 is out. Trickstar Aqua Angel, from 2025, is the newest Marincess card: it is always treated as Marincess, summons itself from the hand or GY next to a Marincess once per Duel, and keeps the Links pointing to it from being destroyed by battle.
main: Marincess Blue Tang
Starter: mills a Marincess; as Link Material, digs three for a Marincess card.
Marincess Sea Horse
Summons itself into a Marincess Link's zone; from the GY, summons another WATER.
Marincess Springirl
Banishes a Marincess to summon itself; mills and burns as Link Material.
Marincess Pascalus
Summons another Marincess from the hand; recovers a Marincess Spell/Trap.
Trickstar Aqua Angel
Newest, treated as Marincess: summons itself once per Duel; protects linked monsters in battle.
Marincess Sleepy Maiden
Summons itself and protects a Marincess card; equips a Link from the GY.
Marincess Basilalima
Searches a Marincess Trap; protects your monsters from the GY.
Marincess Mandarin
Summons itself into a Link's zone from the hand or GY.
Marincess Crown Tail
Hand trap for battle: halves or stops battle damage.
Marincess Battle Ocean
Field Spell: equips spare Marincess Links for ATK; protects Crystal Heart Links.
Marincess Dive
Revives a Marincess, or summons one from the Deck with Battle Ocean up.
Marincess Wave
Negates a monster and makes yours unaffected; from the hand with a Link-3.
Marincess Circulation
Swaps a WATER Link for a Marincess Link of the same rating on either turn.
Marincess Bubble Ring
Stops an attack and summons Crystal Heart.
extra: Link-4 boss: bounces a card and negates Spells/Traps on their turn.
Link-4: draws each Standby Phase and summons a banished Marincess.
Link-4: swaps in an equipped Marincess in battle; revives a Link when destroyed.
Link-3: recovers a Marincess card; stops a battle.
Link-3: searches a Marincess Trap; revives Links.
Link-2: revives a small WATER; recovers a Marincess card when it leaves.
Link-2: unaffected by monster effects in the Extra Monster Zone.
Link-1: recovers a Marincess from the GY.
